title: Bumble Dash
tagline: Dash, boing and double-jump the spring meadow — grab the carrots and beat the clock!
pitch: Bumble Dash: a bunny obstacle-course sprint through a sunny spring meadow. Dash, double-jump and bounce over hurdles, spinning bars and bounce pads, grab golden carrots along the way, and burst through the giant flower finish arch before the timer runs out. Bright, bouncy, cheerful.
controls: Space: jump (again in the air: double jump)

plan.title: Bumble Dash
plan.tagline: Dash, boing and double-jump the spring meadow — grab the carrots and beat the clock!
plan.core_loop: Sprint the winding meadow path, dashing and double-jumping over fence hurdles and spinning bars, boinging off spring pads, grabbing golden carrots, and racing the 90-second clock to the giant flower finish arch.
controls: A / D or arrow keys: move
Space: jump, press again mid-air: double jump
plan.win_condition: Burst through the giant flower finish arch before the 90-second timer runs out.
plan.lose_condition: The timer hits zero, or all 3 lives are lost to spinners, bumblebees and falls.
plan.art_direction: Spring meadow in toon_bright: butter-yellow dandelions and pink tulips on grass green, a winding dirt path, sky blue with cotton-ball clouds; cel shading with soft dark ink outlines, warm morning sun and gentle bloom. References: Animal Crossing spring, Mario 64 meadows, Rayman — bright, bouncy, zero gloom.
concept_shots: Cream bunny with a coral scarf mid double-jump over a wooden fence hurdle, a dotted trail of golden carrots behind, winding dirt path through a flower meadow with a windmill in the distance.
The bunny lands on a spring pad and launches sky-high toward the giant flower finish arch, confetti bursting, arcade timer ticking in the HUD.
A spinning bar hazard whips across the path as a striped bumblebee patrols by and the bunny dashes between them, speed lines trailing behind.

features: Spring pads (World.prop spring_pad + bounce hazard) launch the bunny sky-high with squash-and-stretch pop and a boing SFX
Spinning bar hazards (spinner) sweep the path; touching one knocks the bunny back with hit flash and screen shake
Two patrolling bumblebees (spawnEnemy patrol, yellow-and-black) buzz the course — stomp them for a bounce or lose a life
Speed lines and a dust trail on dashes; sparkle burst and floating +1 text on every carrot pickup
Flower-flag checkpoint at the mid-course river: checkpoint jingle, ring FX, and timer relief
Win: confetti burst and slow-mo as the bunny bursts through the flower arch; lose: screen shake and a sad sting
plan.mapping_notes: The bunny hero maps to Player species 'bunny' with a coral scarf accent. The sunny spring meadow is look toon_bright + level_kind meadow_course, whose built-in set is exactly the pitch: fence hurdles, crate stack, stepping stones over a river, rising blocks, farm and windmill. Golden carrots: the kit has no carrot tag, so the closest look is tag 'seed' (a small tapered golden sprout reads as a carrot), labeled 'Carrots' — 20 placed, 10 shown as the HUD bonus target. The giant flower finish arch is the meadow_course goal arch that Gameplay.rules turns into the goal portal; the flower theme is carried by the tulip props and art direction. Spinning bars = Gameplay hazard 'spinner'; bounce pads = spring_pad prop + 'bounce' hazard; the 'Bumble' in the title becomes two 'patrol' enemies themed as striped bumblebees. Dash and double-jump come stock with the platformer kit. Mode 'goal' with a 90s timer and 3 lives: reach the arch to win, carrots are bonus score — race stays off (laps 0) since this is a sprint, not a lap race.

result.summary: Bumble Dash: a bouncy spring-meadow platformer sprint. A cream bunny with a coral scarf dashes, double-jumps and boings off spring pads through a winding meadow course, grabbing golden carrots (seed pickups, 20 placed / 10 target) and racing a 90-second clock to the flower finish arch. Features: 3 spinner bars across the path, 2 spring bounce pads with "BOING!" text bursts, 2 patrolling bumblebee-style enemies (stompable), checkpoint flags with banners, dash speed lines, win confetti + slow-mo, arcade HUD with carrot counter/timer/hearts/minimap, title screen selling the fantasy, generated sky/props/icons/music/SFX. Built on the scaffold: kept the generated sky, scenery props/splats, HUD, title, and rules; added custom hazard/collectible/enemy placements and extra FX event handlers.
changes: Added 3 spinner bar hazards across the route at 30%/55%/80% with increasing speed
Added 2 spring bounce pads (hazard + spring_pad visual) at 42%/72% of the route
Added extra carrot (seed) collectibles along the route for 20+ total pickups
Added 2 patrol enemies (bumblebees) at 45%/75% of the route
Set objective text: 'Reach the flower arch before the clock runs out!'
Added FX juice: bounce burst + ring + BOING! text, stomp burst + text, dash speed lines + dust, checkpoint banner, win confetti + slow-mo
Configured rules with seed collect (target 10, label Carrots), goal mode, 90s timer, 3 lives, 2 enemies
known_issues: Autopilot is slow to reach the goal (cautious around spinner bars and enemies), but the game is fully playable by a human within the 90s timer
The 'patrol' enemies look like green slimes rather than bumblebees — the kit's patrol enemy is a fixed chibi monster; the bumblebee theme is carried by the title and art direction
